milestones.text: Five pieces in the cases already! Here's a little thank-you, and some bait: fish make fine exhibits. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: Five pieces on the shelves. People are already asking where we got them. A little something for you, and bait: fish count too. - Theo

milestones.text: Ten exhibits! A seed someone left with an old atlas. Nobody knows what it grows. I'd love to. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: Ten pieces in the Curio Room. Found this seed tucked in an old ledger. Grow it and tell me what it is. - Theo

milestones.text: Twenty! School trips have started asking. Consider this your curator's pay. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: Twenty pieces. Folks pay to look now, so you get a cut. Fair's fair. - Theo

milestones.text: Thirty exhibits. The town had a little trophy made for you. It's on your mantel now. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: Thirty pieces. The neighbourhood chipped in for a trophy. It's on your shelf at home. - Theo

milestones.text: Every stone and ore in the valley, in one wing! A little display for your home, too. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: Every stone and ore, all in one room. Made you a display shelf for home. - Theo

milestones.text: The Nature Curios wing is full. I made you a jar of your own. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: The curio shelf is full. Here's a jar of your own for the house. - Theo

milestones.text: Every artifact found! The valley's whole story, on pedestals. A relic shelf for your home. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: Every old piece accounted for, clean provenance and all. A relic shelf for your place. - Theo

milestones.text: Every fish in the tanks. Even the koi! Mounted one for your wall, a pretend one. - Finn
milestones.text_gangsters: Every fish in the tanks. I had a wooden one carved for your wall. - Finn

milestones.text: The museum is complete. I didn't think I'd live to write that. Please take my old loupe: it always finds the lucky things. - Theo
milestones.text_gangsters: The Curio Room is complete. Take my old loupe. It has a habit of spotting the good stuff. - Theo

milestones.text: Twenty-five different things through your sell box! The whole town eats better for it. - Maple
milestones.text_gangsters: Twenty-five different goods through your box. Business likes variety. - Maple

milestones.text: Seventy-five kinds shipped. Here's a ribbon. The fair judges don't give these out for nothing. - Maple
milestones.text_gangsters: Seventy-five kinds of goods. Here's a ribbon for the wall: best supplier on the block. - Maple

milestones.text: A hundred and fifty kinds! I've run out of shelf labels. - Maple
milestones.text_gangsters: A hundred and fifty kinds. I ran out of price tags. - Maple

milestones.text: Ten kinds of fish caught! Bait's on me. - Finn
milestones.text_gangsters: Ten kinds of fish. Bait's on me. - Finn

milestones.text: Every fish the rod can find. You're the best angler this lake has seen. - Finn
milestones.text_gangsters: Every fish a rod can find. Best angler on the waterfront. - Finn

milestones.text: Ten dishes cooked! You've got the touch. - Posy
milestones.text_gangsters: Ten dishes. You cook like you mean it. - Posy

milestones.text: You've cooked every recipe there is. Teach me something now! - Posy
milestones.text_gangsters: Every recipe in the book. Your turn to teach me. - Posy

milestones.text: Twenty-five things built! Have a spare chest for all of it. - Hazel
milestones.text_gangsters: Twenty-five builds. Here's a spare chest. - Hazel

milestones.text: A hundred different builds. You're putting my crew to shame. - Hazel
milestones.text_gangsters: A hundred builds. My crew's getting nervous. - Hazel

milestones.text: Twenty wild things found. The valley shares with those who look. - Willow
milestones.text_gangsters: Twenty wild finds. The city's got more green in it than people think. - Willow

letters.open: The library's east wing is a museum now. Bring me anything old, shiny or scaly: there's a donation tray by the door. - Theo
letters.open_gangsters: The library's east wing is the Curio Room now. Bring me anything old, shiny or scaly; the tray's by the door. I keep the ledger. - Theo
letters.thanks: I catalogued what you left in the tray: %s. The cases look better every day. - Theo
letters.thanks_gangsters: Logged it all in the ledger: %s. Clean provenance, as always. - Theo
letters.not_open: Theo's still dusting the east wing.
